entries.title: Dreaming
entries.description: A Pluck CMS on an Apache server. Exploited a file upload vulnerability to gain a shell, then chained multiple privilege escalation steps to reach root.

entries.title: IDE
entries.description: An exposed FTP service leaks credentials. After gaining a foothold through a vulnerable web service, exploited a sudo misconfiguration to escalate to root.

entries.title: Library
entries.description: Boot2root box from the FIT and BSides Guatemala CTF. Enumerated a hidden login, brute-forced credentials, and leveraged a Python library hijacking for root.

entries.title: Plotted-TMS
entries.description: Traffic Management System running on a misconfigured server. Chained SQL injection and file upload to RCE, then exploited a cron job for privilege escalation.

entries.title: Skynet
entries.description: Terminator-themed machine combining Samba enumeration, Squirrelmail exploitation, and a remote file inclusion leading to a root shell via a wildcard injection.

entries.title: Team
entries.description: Beginner-friendly box. Virtual host enumeration revealed a dev subdomain with an LFI vulnerability. Escalated through SSH keys and a writable script called by cron.
